units.summary: Hook for controlled inputs. Returns `field`, `fieldState`, and `formState`. Re-renders are isolated to the hook level.

guarantees.text: without `shouldUnregister`, the field is not unregistered after unmount (`shouldUnregister` defaults to `false`)
without `disabled`, the field is not disabled (`disabled` defaults to `false`)
`exact` defaults to `true`, so the field does not update when a nested child path changes
with `exact` set to `false`, the field also receives nested updates
the returned `field` has `onChange`, `onBlur`, `value`, `disabled`, `name` and `ref`, and `name` is the registered name
the returned `fieldState` has `invalid`, `isTouched`, `isDirty`, `isValidating` and `error`
a disabled input's value is omitted from the submitted data

units.summary: Hook for dynamic field arrays. Provides `fields` and mutation methods: `append`, `prepend`, `remove`, `insert`, `swap`, `move`, `update`, `replace`.

guarantees.text: each entry of `fields` carries a generated identifier under the key "id" unless `keyName` names another key
`append` adds the given value or values to the end of the array
`prepend` adds the given value or values to the start of the array
`insert(index, value)` adds the given value or values at position `index`
`swap(from, to)` swaps the entries at the two positions
`remove(index)` removes the entry at `index`, and accepts a number or an array of numbers
`remove()` without an argument removes all entries
with `disabled` set to `true`, each entry of `fields` has `disabled` equal to `true` and the mutation methods do nothing

units.summary: Core hook for managing a form. Returns all methods and state for registration, validation, and submission.

guarantees.text: without `mode`, validation first runs on submit (`mode` defaults to "onSubmit")
without `reValidateMode`, fields are re-validated on change after a submit (`reValidateMode` defaults to "onChange")
without `criteriaMode`, only the first error of a field is kept (`criteriaMode` defaults to "firstError")
with `criteriaMode` set to "all", all the errors of a field are collected
without `shouldFocusError`, the first field with an error is focused after a failed submit (`shouldFocusError` defaults to `true`)
without `shouldUnregister`, unmounted fields keep their values (`shouldUnregister` defaults to `false`)
without `disabled`, the form is not disabled (`disabled` defaults to `false`)
when `resolver` is set, the `validate` option does not run

units.summary: Retrieves all `useForm` methods from the nearest `FormProvider`. Use in deeply nested components to avoid prop-drilling.

guarantees.text: returns the methods and props of `useForm` passed to the nearest `FormProvider`
with nested providers, the nearest `FormProvider` is used
outside a `FormProvider`, returns `null`

units.summary: Provides all `useForm` methods to the component tree via React Context. Pair with `useFormContext` to consume them in any descendant.

units.summary: Watches the entire form; re-renders when any value changes.

guarantees.text: with `name` as a string, returns the single value of that field
with `name` as an array, returns an array of the values of those fields
without `name`, returns an object of all form values keyed by field name
